research_scope: Early/base-game Parallel Quest skills from PQ 23, 36, 37, and 39, selected after duplicate screening against the canonical skill index.

verification_audit.method: Candidate identities, categories, costs, and acquisition routes were reconciled against current Xenoverse 2 skill references and the all-PQ reward guide. Unsupported drop probabilities and version-sensitive mechanics were not inferred.

records.name: Death Slash
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 23 — The Explosion of Namek; reward
records.skill_description: Fire a fast, blade-shaped Ki Blast with limited range that lingers briefly after being fired.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation identifies Death Slash as Frieza's Ki Blast Super and lists PQ23 as its acquisition route. Exact drop probability is intentionally unresolved.
records.combo_notes: Short range and fast projectile behavior make confirmation and spacing important; no unsupported frame data is asserted.
records.pve_notes: A compact early-game Ki Blast option with a lingering projectile effect.
records.pvp_notes: The limited range should be considered when documenting neutral applications; exact frame advantage remains unresolved.

records.name: Evil Whirlwind
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 36 — The Cell Games Begin; reward
records.skill_description: A spinning kick that can be used while blocking, knocking the opponent away.
records.mechanics_notes: Xenoverse 2 documentation lists Evil Whirlwind as a Strike Super for Gohan (Teen), with a 100 Ki cost and a 300 stamina cost in its evasive implementation. The PQ36 reward route is corroborated by the all-PQ guide.
records.combo_notes: Because the move has a defensive/blocking interaction, documentation should distinguish its Super implementation from the later Gohan (Beast) Evasive variant.
records.pve_notes: The ability to activate around blocking makes it distinct from ordinary rush Strike Supers.
records.pvp_notes: Do not conflate the Teen Gohan Super with the Gohan (Beast) Evasive variant when documenting defensive behavior.

records.name: Instant Rise
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 37 — Clash! Perfect Cell; reward
records.skill_description: Ascend rapidly while becoming invisible, with directional movement possible during the evasive action.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Instant Rise as an Other Evasive costing 300 stamina and obtainable from PQ37. Its brief invulnerability and movement behavior are documented, while exact frame windows are left unresolved.
records.combo_notes: Primarily a recovery/control evasive rather than an offensive combo starter.
records.pve_notes: Useful for quickly regaining control and repositioning away from an unfavorable exchange.
records.pvp_notes: The short duration and directional movement should be documented without asserting universal frame-perfect punish windows.

records.name: Side Bridge
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 39 — 17 and 18 of the Official History; reward
records.skill_description: Throw a Ki Blast disc forward that returns to the user like a boomerang.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Side Bridge as Android 17's Ki Blast Super, costing 100 Ki and obtainable from PQ39. The returning projectile and two-hit/re-stand characteristics are documented; exact current damage scaling is not promoted as universal.
records.combo_notes: The returning projectile can create unusual timing compared with a conventional one-way disc projectile; detailed frame routes require separate testing.
records.pve_notes: The returning projectile can provide an additional timing layer against AI targets.
records.pvp_notes: Its boomerang behavior can alter spacing and timing, but exact frame interactions remain unresolved.
